name: Enforcer
description: Enforcer for OpenClaw: the Enforcer MCP server, skills, and telemetry to Enforcer governance.

telemetry.description: Send OpenClaw's metrics (cost, tokens, model calls, tools, sessions) to Enforcer governance through diagnostics-otel, with a telemetry-only key for this machine. No prompt or response text.

telemetryLogs.description: Also send the Gateway's own log records (bodies withheld). Off by default: they carry no usage or session data.
